questions.stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes temperature from internal energy?

options.text: Temperature and internal energy are the same thing
Temperature measures the average kinetic energy of particles, while internal energy is the total kinetic and potential energy of all particles
Internal energy measures the average kinetic energy, while temperature is the total energy
Temperature depends on the amount of substance, but internal energy does not

questions.explanation: Temperature is related to the average kinetic energy of particles and does not depend on the amount of substance. Internal energy is the total of all kinetic and potential energies of every particle in the substance, so it does depend on the amount of substance.
